objects.description: [Blue Mockingbird](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0108) has used [FRP](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1144), ssf, and Venom to establish SOCKS proxy connections.(Citation: RedCanary Mockingbird May 2020)
